Ellen (People Ops): Heads-up: we're releasing a concise handbook update clarifying bereavement vs compassionate leave, plus a short FAQ and an accommodations link. Managers required to complete a 12-min microtraining + 5-question quiz. All staff must ack the handbook diff by EOM. Links: https://tiny.redwood/handbook-leave-diff, ack: https://tiny.redwood/ack
Marco (People Ops): Is the manager quiz timeboxed and pass threshold?
Ellen (People Ops): Yes — window = 8 business days. Pass = 80%. Fail twice -> HRBP follow-up.
Yara (HRBP): I'll add a regional callout for statutory differences and collect regional HR sign-off. Also adding a CSV tracking export with a notes column for accommodations.
Chris (Eng Manager): Can we get the manager roster dump and a weekly status file we can ingest into our team dashboard?
reminder-bot: Training created: "Leaves: Bereavement vs Compassionate (2026-09)". Training ID: tr-2026-09-01. Quiz ID: qz-2026-09-01. Results webhook: https://api.redwood.local/training/results/tr-2026-09-01
Ben (Legal): Reviewed. This is clarificatory; not a contract change. If a role or employment agreement references different terms, route to me before sending individualized ack requests.
Marco (People Ops): Planned CSV columns: manager_email,org,team_size,quiz_status,quiz_score,training_viewed,ack_status,ack_ts,region,accommodation_note
Ellen (People Ops): Action owners: Ellen publish announcement + pinned links; Marco automate CSV exports (weekly on Fridays); Yara coordinate regional review; Ben handle escalations. Reminders scheduled at day 4 and day 7. Closing in 8 business days. :white_check_mark:
